meta.title: DevFest Milano 2026
meta.description: The biggest Google Developer community event in Milan. Talks, workshops and networking on October 10, 2026.
meta.tagline: One day. One community. Endless ideas.

stats.title: What to expect
stats.lead: A packed day designed for learning and connecting.

expect.title: Why attend
expect.talksBody: Sessions on AI, Android, Web, Cloud, Flutter and much more, delivered by industry experts.
expect.workshopsBody: Get your hands on the code in practical labs for every experience level.
expect.communityBody: Meet developers, GDEs and community leaders from across Italy and Europe.

theme.title: From generative AI to agents
theme.lead: 2026 is the year AI stops just answering and starts acting. DevFest Milano puts AI at the center — and agentic AI in particular: systems that reason, plan and use tools to get real work done.

models.title: Models & generative AI
models.body: LLMs, multimodality and building products on top of today's models.

agents.title: Agents & tool use
agents.body: Reasoning, planning, orchestration: agents that use tools and APIs to act.

production.title: AI in production
production.body: From prototype to scale: cloud, evaluation, cost and reliability.

responsible.title: Responsible AI
responsible.body: Safety, privacy and impact: building AI you can trust.

featuredSpeakers.lead: A taste of who's taking the stage. The full lineup is on its way.
featuredSpeakers.comingSoon: Speakers will be announced soon. Stay tuned!

speakerTypes.cfpClosedLead: Thanks to everyone who pitched a talk. We're reviewing the proposals and building the agenda — publishing it soon.

communities.title: Two communities, one event
communities.lead: Since 2024, GDG Cloud Milano and GDG Milano have organized DevFest Milano together: two distinct communities, one big day for developers.

past.title: Where we come from
past.lead: Years of DevFest in Milan: thousands of developers, hundreds of talks.

cfp.title: Got something to share?
cfp.lead: The call for speakers is open on Sessionize. Pitch your talk or workshop: we're looking for fresh voices and real stories.
cfp.topicsList: AI & ML, Android, Web, Cloud, Flutter, Kotlin, Firebase, Open Source, DevOps, Accessibility
cfp.closedLead: The call for speakers has closed. The committee is reviewing the proposals and building the DevFest Milano 2026 agenda — publishing it soon.

venue.title: The venue
venue.lead: An easy-to-reach location in the heart of Milan.
venue.tbd: The venue will be announced soon.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.lead: Everything you need to know. Can't find an answer? Reach out.

items.a: DevFest is a community event with a symbolic price. You'll find all the details on the registration page.

items.q: Is the event in Italian or English?
items.a: Both: there will be talks in Italian and English. Each session shows its language in the agenda.
Yes! The call for speakers is open on Sessionize until the stated deadline.
items.aClosed: Submissions are closed. The committee is selecting the talks and building the agenda, which we'll publish soon.

items.q: Is there a code of conduct?
items.a: Yes. Everyone attending must follow our Code of Conduct, linked in the footer.

items.q: Will I get a certificate of attendance?
items.a: Details on certificates and digital badges will be shared with registrants by email.

footer.tagline: The annual Google Developer community event in Milan.
footer.newsletterBody: We announce tickets and updates through our two communities. Follow both so you don't miss the drop.
footer.ticketsBody: Registration is open on the GDG platform. Seats are limited — grab your ticket.
footer.by: by the GDG Cloud Milano & GDG Milano volunteers
footer.disclaimer: DevFest Milano is an independent event organized by the community. Google and the Google logo are not affiliated with and do not sponsor the event.
